body:
@bobylito Aside from that, I have the feeling trying to mix documentation AND live demo (with all widgets belonging to a single instantsearch instance) is not the right thing to do in the end.

That's why I proposed to isolate every widget in his own instantsearch instance.

We may get used to it us developers since it's like that since the begining. But my first reaction when testing it was "Who! Something is moving behind this widget I am testing, I do not know what but it is moving, down below" => because refining/querying will change the page height.

I guess if I am just starting with the library, if I really want to see a full example I will go to > Examples.

The way the live documentation is done right now can be disturbing for newcomers to the library I believe. Maybe @ElPicador you can share your experience of discovering the documentation was "live".
